directPaymentDiscovery.note: Official pages confirm charge-it-easy can be used without registration and paid by Visa, Mastercard or American Express. The standard tariff is 0.55 EUR/kWh. A charge-it-easy transaction below 0.50 EUR is rounded up to 0.50 EUR, and the published blocking fee is 0.50 EUR per 30 minutes after full charge.

reason: Exact primary pricing is known, but the current verified TCC direct-offer schema does not safely encode both minimum-transaction rounding and a blocking fee triggered specifically after full charge. No lossy runtime offer is emitted.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Verified TCC semantics for minimum billed transaction and post-full-charge blocking, or an explicit schema-extension decision before runtime integration.
